name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 317 drones overnight to 9 Nov; talks 10–11 Nov
summary: Russia sent 317 drones overnight to 9 Nov and hit the grid; Abu Dhabi talks due 10–11 Nov; Zaporizhzhia off-grid 8 Nov
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 317 drones overnight to 9 Nov, and Russia's defence ministry said it targeted four electrical substations (AP). Leningrad's governor said 113 Ukrainian drones were downed and a fire broke out at the Kirishi refinery (AP; Kyiv Independent). The Zaporizhzhia plant lost all off-site power on 8 Nov for the 27th time before it was restored (IAEA via Kyiv Independent; Anadolu); that safety incident sets the Alert. Trilateral talks with US mediation are due in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov (SANA).
for_you: Civilians in Ukraine face continued power cuts as winter sets in. FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine. Europe's energy and defence costs remain exposed to the course of the talks.
rubric_hit: Nuclear-plant safety incident: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power on 8 Nov (IAEA)
